visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair tied up is seen in a brightly lit indoor bathroom. She is naked from the shoulders up, covered in white soapy foam while washing her hair. She holds a black, microphone-shaped showerhead close to her face, with water spraying out of it like a curtain. She has her eyes closed and her mouth open in a dramatic, singing expression. (2) She continues the same action, scrubbing her hair with her right hand while the left hand holds the microphone showerhead. The background consists of wet glass shower doors and white tiled walls. The lighting is consistent and bright. Her facial expressions remain intense and emotional as if performing on stage. (3) She momentarily pulls the showerhead away to wipe foam from her eyes with her palm before bringing it back to her mouth. The water continues to pour over her face and hair. The scene is static with a handheld feel, focusing entirely on her humorous shower performance.
